- Warm/Cool White LED Icicle Lights
- Black or White Rubber Cable Options
- Connectable Up to 50m Length

Perfect for creating a cosy winter ambience or a sparkling summer feature, they are ideal for gutters, eaves, patios, decking, pergolas and indoor areas. The connectable design allows you to easily build the right length for your space, with 2m or 5m sections that link together up to 50m. Each set features long-lasting, energy-efficient LED bulbs for consistent, reliable performance. The robust rubber cable and waterproof connectors ensure durability in all weather conditions, making them suitable for year-round use. Choose between black or white cable to match your surroundings, and select from static or twinkle effects to suit your style. As part of our mains voltage connectable range, these lights can be easily expanded for larger displays. Combining professional quality with simple installation, our LED Icicle Lights bring warmth, elegance and brilliance to any occasion, transforming everyday spaces or festive scenes with ease and charm.
